Rahul ji, samajh sakta hoon ki salary ka intezaar karne mein thoda waqt lagta hai. Par humara policy hai ki koi bhi discount ya waiver nahi diya ja sakta, chahe situation kaisi bhi ho.

Aapne 5 tareekh ko 10,000 rupaye bhejne ka plan bataya hai. Kya aap mujhe confirm kar sakte hain ki wo paise kab tak transfer honge?
